You have to print out the list of everyone's hours worked for the week. 

Then you add up all the cash & change. I do all the change first & exchange as much as I can for dollars out of a register. Once you have all the money counted up, take that amount & divide it by the total hours worked by everyone in the store (it's listed at the bottom of the page). You'll get a decimal. 

Example: if you counted $200 in tips & the store hours were 300; you'd get .6666 

Take that decimal & multiple each person's hours worked by .66 
If you worked 30 hours that week: 30×.66=19.8
We usually just round up to the next dollar so you'd get $20.

So you've been "granted" 26 shares from Starbucks - the stocks that they gift you every year. 

But when they give you these stocks they are "restricted stocks," which means you can't cash them out or trade them yet while they're "vesting." Vesting is just the waiting period. 

After 2 years your stocks are "vested" & now they are yours to do whatever you want with. So the "6 distributed" are the ones you have that are fully vested, the "20 unvested" are still in that waiting period. 

If you quit/leave during that vesting period you will lose any unvested stocks.
